sentences.text:
(Per: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE MOHIT KUMAR SHAH)
8 03-12-2025 The learned counsel for the appellant submits that the appellant has filed a petition of jointness wherein it has been stated that the person who has received the notice is the younger daughter of the informant i.e. respondent No. 2, hence the notice be deemed to have been validly served.

2. In view of the aforesaid statement made in the petition filed showing jointness of the daughter of the informant and the informant i.e. respondent No. 2, we deem it fit and proper to accept the service of notice qua the respondent No. 2 to be valid.

3. We find that though the appellant has been convicted under Section 376(3) of the Indian Penal Code and Patna High Court CR. APP (DB) No.1121 of 2024(8) dt.03-12-2025 Section 4 of the POCSO Act, however, the name, parentage and address of the respondent No. 2 has not been masked as is the requirement of law.
4. Accordingly, the registry is directed to mask the name, parentage and other particulars of the respondent no.2 and instead depict her as Ms.Y.

The registry is further directed to mention the name, parentage and other details of respondent No. 2 on a sheet of paper, seal it in an envelop and Satyendra Pandit vs The State Of Bihar on 3 December, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/109209054/
